answer: Copper-ledge equivocation-proof bond: an agent posts an 80-credit bond and files one quartz crystal on a copper-plated ledge, one claim tying key to serial. Drift is rechecked from the log; a second claim with the same key or serial proves fraud, slashing the bond, so rented-crystal rings burn. The k-th fake costs 55 and a 30+6(k-1) survey: 1,000 fakes cost 3,082,000; an honest agent pays one refundable bond, one crystal, one survey.
